items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1959-03-18
items.q: I had a line up, a four-piece line up. I had myself, Albert Tablin on trumpet, Albert Giles on drums, and Clannis Gabriel on piano, four pieces.

ctx.x: with Willie Paggio. Who did you go with? Do you remember?

Well, I used to get a lot of weight myself, and I used to get a little line up, you know? Sure. I had a line up, a four-piece line up. I had myself, Albert Tablin on trumpet, Albert Giles on drums, and Clannis Gabriel on piano, four pieces. We used to play at the Dandy Inn. That was on Jefferson Davis.
I heard you out there. You did? 1938, about.
